# CANDIDATE: SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE2_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that tightening the stop loss to -30% of premium and setting take profit at 50% of premium will improve the shotgun_scalper strategy by reducing losses on losing days while maintaining profitability on winning days. The volume ratio threshold (1.2) and chandelier arm (50%) are intended to filter low-quality entries and lock in profits during strong moves.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Triggered when volume ratio exceeds vol_ratio_threshold (1.2) and other internal conditions of the shotgun_scalper strategy are met (exact entry logic not specified in parameters).  
**Exit:**  
- Take profit at +50% of entry premium (tp_premium_pct=0.5)  
- Stop loss at -30% of entry premium (stop_premium_pct=-0.3)  
- Time stop after 10 minutes (time_stop_min=10)  
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at 50% of highest premium reached (chandelier_arm_pct=0.5) and trails by a fixed amount (unspecified in combo; assumed to be standard 15% trail as per v15).  
Strike selection: strike_offset=2 implies 2 strikes OTM for puts (or ITM for calls; direction assumed put-based given OP-16 context).
